title: Hello Sunshine | Bright 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Hello Sunshine is a pet friendly, one level Seagrove cottage with a large private pool, fenced yard, bikes, and an easy walk to the beach and Seaside.
description_expanded: Beautiful and cozy beach cottage in Old Seagrove Beach. Only a short 5-minute stroll to the Live Oak or Nightcap Beach Access, this designer pet friendly Seagrove home features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, parking for 4 cars, an oversized deep pool, and large fenced-in yard. This 30A home is only a 4-minute bike ride to shopping and dining in Seaside. Hello Sunshine is perfect for anyone who wants to be super close to 30A while also enjoying a more peaceful neighborhood. The large backyard is fenced-in for privacy and has a calming atmosphere - it is perfect for sunbathing or even pulling out your Yoga mat for restorative moments. Designer bedding, plush Posturepedic mattresses, and Pacific Coast pillows are featured in the guest rooms for a luxurious experience. Your pup will love this house just as much as you will! The fenced-in backyard and grassy front yard is great for throwing the ball. The quiet Seagrove roads are perfect for leisurely strolls with your pup. The home is also one level, making it easy for your dog and you to move around in peace. Hello Sunshine Features - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - All one level. No Stairs! - Large Private pool - Approx 15 x 36. Pool heating available for an additional fee for arrivals October 1 - April 30 - 5 Min. stroll to Live Oak or Nightcap Beach Entrances - 4 Min bike ride to shopping and dining in Seaside - 2 Min bike ride to Seagrove Village Market - 4 Min to Publix, The Perfect Pig, Pizza by the Sea, Pedego Electric Bikes and Driftwood Wine and Spirits - Flexible Summer Stays! Stays less than 7 nights available - Enjoy 3 Taxi bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape for your arrival - Beach cart available to carry your supplies to the beach - Lounge seating next to the private pool - Fenced-in backyard with outdoor propane grill and outdoor dining - Outdoor shower with hot water - Large, landscaped front yard - Driveway parking for 4 cars - Full kitchen with stainless steel appliances including Bosch, Samsung and Keurig - TVs throughout home - Dining for 6 plus adjacent Breakfast Bar seating for 4 - Workspace with desk and chair in the king suite - Laundry room with HE Washer and Dryer - Cable and WIFI - Posturepedic Mattresses in the guest rooms - Concierge services including grocery delivery, electric bike rentals, golf cart rentals, baby equipment rentals, and chartered boats available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
